profile.summary: Mills College at Northeastern University is the Oakland campus of Northeastern University, a private nonprofit university based in Boston. Its Mills Institute runs federally funded TRIO programs, including Upward Bound and Mills Educational Talent Search, which help first-generation and low-income students in Oakland prepare for and apply to college.
